title: Unimpressed with colors and poor shape in which it arrived.
text:
Unimpressed with colors and poor shape in which it arrived.. Colors definitely not as vibrant as those in the seller's page.

In addition, the fabric was sompletely wrinkled. As if someone had bought it, bunched it up into a ball and then returned it...and then I was the lucky recipient if this returned item.

The one positive is that the fabric itself is a big heavier than I expected and not flimsy.
